svg.title: MainStreet America — Showcase Street (isometric massing mockup)
svg.desc: MASSING MOCKUP — NOT A SCREENSHOT OF THE WORLD. Stylised voxel massing studies of block SHELLS. Only the home names, style names, square footages and the RCON-measured as-built footprints are source-verified; every facade material, colour, roof form, window and detail is a creative approximation.

footprint sizes and all colour are stylisation.

parcel fronted I-45 on its WEST side.

Mason · Architect · Steward · Scout · Surveyor — all opped, level 4
A hand-drawn isometric massing study of block SHELLS. Not a render, not a capture of the running world, and nothing here was traced from a screenshot.
VERIFIED (source-grounded): the twelve home names, their architectural style names, square footages and storey counts; the Guest Center at 44,019 SF / 2 storeys; and every
as-built dimension, height and material in the panel at right, probed block-by-block against the live server on 2026-07-24 (qa/as-built-survey.md).
CREATIVE APPROXIMATION (invented for this build): every facade material, colour, roof form, window and door; which named home sits on which lot; the per-home footprint sizes
drawn here; the lawns, aprons and grading detail; and the three lots marked ○. No retrieved source documents what any of these buildings actually looked like (REF-019).
